{{Top|leg}}
'''Ghecharo''' was a [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] who visited [[Exovar's Emporium]] on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] for a hunting expedition. When [[Kaori Batta]] tried to cancel it due to bad weather, Ghecharo insisted they go on as planned, stating his royal itinerary could not be changed.

While out hunting, they stumbled upon a wounded [[modrol]] hiding in a cave. Kaori attempted to talk Ghecharo into avoiding the dangerous animal, but Ghecharo considered this cowardly and instead entered the cave with his [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] [[Kleck]] where he was killed by the modrol.
